title: Why hiring a senior lawyer is not a growth strategy
description: Every year, professional services firms announce marquee lateral hires with great optimism. Law firms welcome celebrated partners. Consulting firms recruit industry leaders. Accounting firms attract specialists with deep client relationships. Executive search firms hire rainmakers with impressive networks.The expectation is familiar.
